The case: Yang operated a Chinese medicine department of a company, without drug production license, purchased raw Chinese herbal pieces, repackaged and relabeled them, sold. This is illegal drug manufacturing/processing without license, also illegal sale of unlicensed drugs. Likely crimes: illegal manufacturing of medicinal products (非法生产、销售药品) – under Chinese criminal law, "非法生产、销售假药" or "非法生产、销售药品" (if not counterfeit but unlicensed). Also "非法经营罪" maybe. The examples: For virtual invoice they used "虚开增值税专用发票". For illegal manufacturing of explosives they used "非法制造、买卖、运输、邮寄、储存枪支、弹药、爆炸物". For illegal occupation of land they used "非法占用农用地". For illegal manufacturing of explosives they used "非法制造、买卖、运输、邮寄、储存枪支、弹药、爆炸物". For illegal manufacturing of drugs? Not seen. But there is "非法种植毒品原植物". For illegal manufacturing of medical devices? Not. For illegal manufacturing of medicine, Chinese law: "非法生产、销售假药罪" (if counterfeit) or "非法生产、销售药品罪". The facts: they didn't have production license, but they repackaged and labeled, maybe considered "非法生产、销售药品". Also "非法经营罪" for operating without license. The typical charge: "非法生产、销售药品罪". Also maybe "非法经营罪" (illegal business). But the main is illegal production and sale of Chinese medicinal materials without license. So answer: [罪名]非法生产、销售药品<eoa>.
